item.title: No, George Washington didn’t have wooden teeth. Yes, he led the Siege of Boston
item.description: More than a decade before he became the country's first president, George Washington was leading a critical campaign in the early days of the American Revolution.

item.title: Brazil’s first Winter Games gold is about much more than the medal
item.description: It was the first-ever medal at the Winter Games for any country in South America. And not just any medal: Gold.

item.title: Avalanche watch issued for much of Utah as heavy snow expected
item.description: The Utah Avalanche Center issued an avalanche watch on Monday morning, as heavy snow is expected across much of Utah in the coming days.

item.title: Robert Duvall, Oscar-winning actor and ‘Godfather’ mainstay, dead at 95
item.description: Robert Duvall, the Oscar-winning actor of matchless versatility and dedication whose classic roles included the intrepid consigliere of the first two "Godfather" movies and the over-the-hill country music singer in "Tender Mercies," has died at age 95.

item.title: Man accused of abusing teen girl on University of Utah campus
item.description: A 30-year-old man is accused of sexually abusing a teen girl on the campus of the University of Utah.

item.title: Police investigating after man hit, killed in West Jordan
item.description: Police are investigating a fatal car crash that occurred Sunday evening in West Jordan.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie kidnapping investigators work with Walmart after identifying suspect’s backpack
item.description: Investigators working on the disappearance of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie's mother are consulting with Walmart management to develop leads because a backpack the suspect was wearing is sold exclusively at the stores, the Pima County, Arizona, sheriff said Monday.

item.title: 3 killed, including suspect, in shooting at a Rhode Island hockey rink
item.description: Authorities said three people were killed, including the suspect, at a shooting at a Rhode Island hockey rink on Monday afternoon where a youth hockey game was scheduled.

item.title: The future of American nuclear energy just touched down in Utah
item.description: The U.S. Department of War airlifted a miniature nuclear reactor across the American West on Sunday, marking a historic shift in what is possible in the world of energy production.

item.title: Tooele County confirms first case of measles
item.description: Health officials in Tooele County confirmed the county's first case of measles Monday night.
